# UX Checklist: Booking Screens

**Purpose**: UX requirements: error messages, refresh behavior and empty states
**Created**: 2026-10-18
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Error Messages

- [ ] CHK001 Is "plain language" defined for refusal messages, including which details they must name (the clash interval, the rule, the room)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK002 Are message requirements defined for every refusal class (clash, rule violation, deactivated room, unknown room, too late to cancel, unreachable system)? [Completeness, Spec §US2, §US3]
- [ ] CHK003 Is "next to the form" specified for refusals that concern no single field? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK004 Is it specified that entered data is kept for every kind of failure, including an unreachable system? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §US2 Scenario 4]
- [ ] CHK005 Are the pre-checks that run before submission listed, and is it clear which rules the screen must not duplicate? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK006 Are error requirements for a failed cancellation specified, including what the list shows afterwards? [Coverage, Spec §US3 Scenario 6]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the behavior defined when the day view or the list fails to load, including how to retry? [Gap, Spec §US1 Scenario 5]

## Refresh Behavior

- [ ] CHK008 Is "refreshes after a booking is created or cancelled" quantified (how soon, and what stays in place, such as scroll position and selection)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-008, §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK009 Is it specified whether the day view refreshes when the user returns to it or when another person books in the meantime? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the interaction between a refresh and an open form defined (does the form stay and keep its values)? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK011 Are loading states defined for the day view, the list and cancellation, including how long before a failure is assumed? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the motion on refresh specified together with the reduced-motion behavior? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the effect on My bookings of a booking made from the day view specified (listed without a manual reload)? [Gap, Spec §US3]

## Empty States

- [ ] CHK014 Are empty states defined for every collection: day with no bookings, weekend, no active rooms, no bookings for a name, no name entered? [Coverage, Spec §US1 Scenario 2-3, §US3 Scenario 5]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the tone of every empty state specified consistently with the rest of the application? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK016 Is it specified what happens when there are no active rooms to book? [Gap, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the unavailable state of past periods on today's date defined with its label and icon? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK018 Are the default room and date rules unambiguous when today is a weekend or all rooms are inactive? [Ambiguity, Spec §Clarifications]

## Cross-cutting

- [ ] CHK019 Are the label and icon of each period state (free, booked, own, cancelled, past) specified, not only that they differ? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the cancellation boundary stated identically in the user story, the requirement and the clarification? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the reason shown for a disabled Cancel specified for each cause (inside an hour, already started)? [Completeness, Spec §US3 Scenario 3]
- [ ] CHK022 Are the keyboard behaviors specified for choosing a period, opening and closing the form, and returning focus? [Gap, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the remembered organizer name's scope and way to change or forget it specified? [Gap, Spec §Clarifications]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
